answerBox.snippet: Oxyrase® for Agar (OA) is a sterile, enzyme-based supplement that utilizes the proprietary Oxyrase® Enzyme System—consisting of bacterial membrane fragments and substrates—to catalytically remove dissolved oxygen from agar media, creating stable reduced environments for cultivating oxygen-sensitive microorganisms.
